scope: IMP-06: install task outcome survives a page switch
status: implemented-and-ui-verified; real long-running install not exercised

reviewFindings.installTasks: gap: a successful task was removed from the backend two seconds after finishing, so leaving the page lost the outcome
reviewFindings.scanTasks: covered: package scan keeps a snapshot with running/done/partial/canceled/error and a cancel flag
reviewFindings.migrationUpdateDelete: already synchronous requests with immediate results; no background task store to lose
reviewFindings.unifiedContract: deferred: statuses are still strings for scan/reinstall and an enum for install; a shared contract is a refactor, not a defect fix

implementation: the backend now keeps a finished install task for FINISHED_TASK_TTL_SECS (30 minutes) instead of 2 seconds
error and canceled tasks were already retained; they now share the same window
installStore gains dismiss(), which hides a finished task locally without discarding the backend record
dismiss refuses to remove a task that is still downloading or installing, so a stale timer cannot hide a running job
init merges the backend snapshot instead of replacing the map, so a task finishing during the request is not dropped
Download.tsx uses dismiss() for the post-toast cleanup and reports canceled tasks that completed elsewhere

uiCoverage.download-ui: the fixture snapshot now includes done, error and canceled tasks that finished elsewhere; the test asserts all three are reported once on first entry, then that returning to the page does not repeat the toast, and existing cancel-button assertions still pass

ui.command: node tests/run-ui.mjs <global playwright module> tests/settings-ui.mjs tests/startup-ui.mjs tests/release-052-ui.mjs tests/download-ui.mjs tests/package-manager-update-ui.mjs tests/scans-ui.mjs tests/scan-ui.mjs tests/sizes-ui.mjs tests/packages-ui.mjs

notVerified: No real multi-minute install was run to observe the retention window
The app was not restarted between the start and the page switch; recovery was exercised through the snapshot path
limitations: A finished task disappears after 30 minutes even if never viewed
Task state is in memory, so an app restart still loses finished outcomes
Scan and reinstall tasks keep their own status vocabularies; unifying them remains open work
